policy: The pre-v16 GBS desktop submenu (labels + order + item count) is restored verbatim from the canonical historical witness bcf6389f29ee0c89e9e96e7587e0226ecf251ae0. During the Astro migration 7 anchor IDs were renamed; labels and target headings are preserved. These renames are the ONLY differences between the historical witness and the current render. They are legitimate (label-preserving) and MUST be applied by scripts/gill-pre-v16-submenu-regression-audit.js (via the "renames" map below) when comparing the historical reference manifest to the current build, so the manifest historical hrefs resolve to the current rendered anchors.
